hooks.prompt: Check the gala_launchpad_* tool result. If it indicates the MCP server is missing (unknown tool, tool not found, or no matching tool), do not call more GalaChain tools. Tell the user the MCP server is not installed and direct them to /omni-tool:setup, or show this ~/.claude.json entry: {"mcpServers":{"gala-launchpad":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","@gala-chain/launchpad-mcp-server@^7.0.0"],"env":{"ENVIRONMENT":"prod"}}}}. Tell them the only environments are prod (real GalaChain mainnet) and stage (test network); set ENVIRONMENT to exactly one of those values and restart Claude Code. For other errors, identify the feature and call gala_launchpad_explain_sdk_usage with the most relevant valid topic. Its topic enum is the live source of truth, including topics added by newer servers, so use the exact current enum value. Local fallback examples include buy-tokens, sell-tokens, balances, installation, and queued-swap-recovery.
